facts.fact: Opposition politician Maurice Kamto said thousands of names were expunged from Cameroon's national voter register in a December 2024 database clean-up over rejected fingerprints, about 12,000 voters according to the article, and ELECAM launched its 2025 annual biometric voter registration cycle on 6 January aiming for at least eight million names.

Gabon launched biometric voter registration early in January 2025, due to end on 31 January, with the government expecting around 300,000 new voters to enroll on the electoral register, according to VOA as reported.
